name: robots/openai__robosumo
title: OpenAI RoboSumo Ant-vs-Ant (two-agent MuJoCo sumo)
intro: OpenAI RoboSumo Ant-vs-Ant (two-agent MuJoCo sumo), adapted from openai/robosumo. It reads `observation`, `reward`, `terminated`, `truncated` and 4 more; runs `step`, `reset` and `seed`. `step`: advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
serve_http: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/robots/openai__robosumo --backend fake --port 7400
serve_mcp: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/robots/openai__robosumo --backend fake --mcp
